detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Golf balls have been piling up in the yard for a long time, and they can’t go anywhere on their own. Roll up your sleeves and get to work to completely clean up this yard!

COLLECT, UPGRADE, REPEAT - RELAX & CLEAN

Every ball you grab turns into cash, and every bit of cash brings you closer to the next tool. What starts as a slow, one-ball-at-a-time grind soon snowballs into clearing entire fields in seconds.

FROM BARE HANDS TO BIG TOOLS

Start with nothing but your two hands. Save up for new tools & upgrades, and eventually swallow hundreds of balls in one pass. Upgrade each tool to push your collection speed further and further.

A LITTLE NOTEBOOK FULL OF JOBS

Completing various tasks will give you extra benefits and unlock certain achievements. To speed up the process, it’s a good idea to check your tasks in your little notebook!

EXPLORE MYSTERIOUS AREAS

We will not elaborate further on this matter...
